description: This file defines data models and functions related to OpenAI model responses, including classes for completion, message, choice, and delta, as well as utility functions for creating and streaming responses.

classes.name: OpenAIDelta
classes.description: Represents a piece of completion content to be concatenated for full message.

classes.name: OpenAIMessage
classes.description: Represents an inference message with role and content.

classes.name: OpenAIChoice
classes.description: Represents a choice from the AI response, including delta or message, sources, and finish reason.

classes.name: OpenAICompletion
classes.description: Represents a completion response similar to OpenAI's API, with methods to create from text or delta, and to dump JSON.

methods.name: from_text
methods.description: Creates an OpenAICompletion instance from text, finish reason, and sources.

methods.name: json_from_delta
methods.description: Serializes the completion delta to JSON format.
